result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the restaurant carousel and its timing badges have visible overlap/cropping issues.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel begins too far to the right, leaving its restaurant title and delivery text cut off. Although a partially visible final carousel card is expected, the card’s content is also visually competing with the viewport edge and feels abruptly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel uses consistent card widths and end padding, so partially visible cards remain intentionally previewed without their internal text appearing awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The “20–30 min” ETA badge on the third Fastest near you card extends beyond the right edge and is visibly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Keep ETA badges within each card’s image bounds and apply sufficient internal/right-edge spacing or clipping to the card container.
